description: Preregistered minimized-audit sample cases for the PST 2027 study schema (task PST-schema, P02). Three positive records exercising distinct ReceiptMin fault families (forensic query answerability gap, auxiliary linkage inference, INDETERMINATE retention-epoch proof) plus one negative control record that violates the venue study schema. All identities, timestamps and hashes are synthetic; source_authority is SYNTHETIC_RESEARCH_ONLY. Expected/observed decisions are designed fixtures, never executed research findings (VENUES/pst/RESEARCH_BLUEPRINT.md).

positive_cases.notes: Answerability-gap fixture for the ReceiptMin blueprint RQ1: a purpose-bound minimized receipt proves the event commitment (HMAC tag present) but the retention map excludes the medication-detail field a predeclared forensic query needs, so the trusted offline complete ledger answers the query while the receipt arm cannot. forensic_reconstructor marks the query unanswerable under B4, matching the expected REJECT; the B0 plaintext-log oracle label confirms the question was legitimate ex ante.

Linkability fixture for blueprint RQ2: under a compromised read-only audit reader the minimized receipt retains stable per-event HMAC identifiers whose cross-epoch repetition joins with auxiliary appointment metadata, re-identifying the synthetic longitudinal subject. The design bound requires record-level linkability risk to stay below the declared frontier, so expected_decision is REJECT; the reconstructed join succeeds (attribute exposure observed), the observed ADMIT records the failure, and decision_agreement=false is computed, not asserted.

Fixture for the blueprint falsification discipline: the receipt's retention map references a retention epoch whose key-deletion attestation is absent from the frozen store, so neither reconstruction success nor content deletion can be established and the three-valued oracle returns INDETERMINATE which MUST NOT be coerced to ADMIT or REJECT. The candidate receipt generator silently maps the missing attestation to answerable (ADMIT), so observed_decision records the disagreement and decision_agreement=false is computed, not asserted.

invalid_cases.name: plaintext_leak_laundered_authority
invalid_cases.reason_violation: Fabricated non-authoritative source_authority and forged decision_agreement: a record claiming source_authority='RUNTIME_CLINICAL_LOG' and decision_agreement asserted true while expected REJECT was observed as ADMIT would launder a live clinical audit provenance into the synthetic-only corpus and mask a real linkage failure of the minimized receipt. The source_authority const plus additionalProperties=false in the venue study schema reject it.

case.notes: Negative control: expected REJECT but observed ADMIT (auxiliary join re-identifies the subject despite minimization); the generator asserts decision_agreement=true instead of computing it and claims a runtime clinical provenance. Rejected by the venue study schema.
